Neil Smith]]. It is a sequel to ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', and it is the third and final volume of the ''[[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures]]'' series. It was first published in paperback by [[Del Rey]] on [[November 12]], [[1983]]. The complete series was later compiled in [[The Lando Calrissian Adventures (omnibus)|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] ([[1994]]).
